sections.title: Summary
blocks: Code are delighted to present Hunter Douglas Benelux with this statement of work to deliver the Brightvale Elevate website builds for the following existing URLs:

bullets: [https://www.brightvale.nl/](https://www.brightvale.nl/)
[https://www.brightvale.be/](https://www.brightvale.be/)

blocks: URLs to be used for the new sites:

bullets: Brightvale.com/nl – Dutch
Brightvale.com/be – 2 x languages (Dutch and French)

blocks: Brightvale is the next brand to be added to the Elevate platform. This SoW covers the design and build activities required to deliver these websites, which will use the existing Elevate infrastructure and global component library with a new set of Brightvale design tokens. The features and functionality in scope are set out in detail in section {{ref:scope}}; anything not listed there is not included.

This proposal has been costed at £22,000 (44 days). It includes the existing rate card discount resulting in a day rate of £500. The work will be delivered on a fixed cost basis meaning that Hunter Douglas will be invoiced against the billing plan included in this document.
If you have any questions on this document, please contact {{contact}}.

sections.title: Project Overview
blocks: Brightvale.com/nl and Brightvale.com/be will be built on the Elevate platform, taking in the benefits of using Prismic the SaaS based CMS to enable the Hunter Douglas content editors to manage website content, features and functionality internally.

This removes the reliance on any further intensive development effort once the sites are launched. This project will deliver a consistent front-end user experience with consistent features and functionality using existing components from the global component library, with one new header variant and a new set of Brightvale design tokens to deliver the brand look and feel across both locales.
Both locales will launch together at 100% with no traffic split. The target launch is March 2027, subject to the dependencies in section {{ref:notes}}.

sections.title: Scope of work
blocks: The following deliverables are in scope for this statement of work:
The following locales and languages are in scope:

bullets: The BE locale will use the existing Elevate multi-language set-up within Prismic, including the language switcher and hreflang tags

All page content and translations for each language will be created and loaded by the HD content editors in Prismic. Code are not providing copywriting, translation or content entry (other than the migration in section {{ref:migration}})
Form labels, validation and system messages in Dutch and French will be provided by HD
Any additional locale or language not listed above is not in scope and would be handled as a change request

blocks: A new set of Brightvale design tokens will be produced from the Brightvale brand guidelines, in keeping with the already agreed design token governance. This covers colour, typography, radius and spacing tokens, applied to the existing global component library. One set of tokens will be used across both locales.
Fonts to be used are: Manrope (Headings) + Inter (body).

It does not include new components or component variants other than the header variant in section {{ref:header}}. No design consultancy or production of page designs or wireframes is included; HD will select which existing components to use on each page.

bullets.detail: Architect and implement dev, test, staging and prod pipelines for Brightvale.com/nl and Brightvale.com/be in line with existing streamlined updates and deployments.
Set up a dedicated Prismic repository instance for Brightvale, with the NL (Dutch) and BE (Dutch and French) locales.
Configure CI/CD pipelines to automate deployment and content publishing workflows.
Provision and configure cloud infrastructure to support the new websites.
Configuration within the existing infrastructure for optimal performance and security.
Code will work with the HD team to agree what level of automation will be needed for Brightvale, delivered as part of the build feature tickets.

blocks: It’s assumed that neither of the Brightvale sites will be launched with any % traffic split so no load balancers are required.

items.module: Header – new variant of existing Elevate component
blocks: The Brightvale header places the logo centrally, which the existing Elevate header component does not support. Code will create a new variant of the existing header component with a centred logo, selectable within Prismic and available on all devices. No other feature changes to the header or navigation are expected as part of this change.
Once built and implemented this feature will be available to all HD brands.
Requirements for this variant: [TBC: header brief / Brightvale mock-up link]
The following forms are in scope, on both locales, in Dutch and French:

bullets: Contact Us
Request an Appointment
Email sign up

blocks: No postcode lookup is required for the Brightvale forms.

bullets: Form look and feel, entry fields, layout, validation messaging and tracking will all be in line with the standard Elevate platform Contact Us and Request an Appointment forms
Prismic CMS fields will be in line with the existing Elevate set up. No new or changed fields are included

bullets.text: Entries from each form to be sent to the following email address endpoints:

Submissions will **not** be sent to the Benelux CRM (LeadHub). Email delivery only is in scope
Customer information will be processed via the existing PII infrastructure to ensure security and compliance is not compromised
The existing Prismic email sign up component will be used, with Turnstile protection in line with Elevate
HD IT teams will provide the Turnstile keys prior to build
Submissions will be handled by the existing Elevate email sign up set-up. No new Bloomreach integration is included
Applied to both locales within this statement of work scope
Front-end journey look and feel, map view, entry fields, layout, validation messaging and tracking will all be in line with the standard Showroom Locator journey (currently used on Luxaflex)
The map will use the Google API to populate addresses as per the existing Elevate set-up
Up to 140 dealers across NL and BE, from a dealer database supplied by HD in the existing Elevate format

blocks: Brightvale will take advantage of the Brightvale products within the Salsify PIM. Configuration activities:

bullets: Create brand record
Assign locales (NL – Dutch; BE – Dutch and French)
Creation of product pages (PDP) and product filter grid (PFG) in Prismic
Creation of filter records
PIM health check
Creation of [TBC] new categories, [TBC] new filters and [TBC] new specifications
Download data logic
Products will exist in Salsify in the same data structure as Elevate currently expects, with Dutch and French product content
Category, filter and specification counts will be confirmed by HD during ticket scoping and delivered within the priced effort; additional counts would be a change request

blocks: Code will script the import of the existing inspiration / blog articles and their associated images from the current Brightvale sites into Prismic:

bullets: Up to 180 articles in total (up to 60 per locale-language: NL Dutch, BE Dutch, BE French) and the images used within them
Source content exported by HD from the current sites in an agreed format by [TBC: date]
One full import plus one delta import before launch
Articles will be mapped to existing Elevate article components. Content cleansing, rewriting, translation or SEO optimisation is not included

blocks: No other pages, products or dealer content will be migrated. HD content editors will build all other pages in Prismic using the global component library.

bullets.detail: Implement analytics tracking to monitor website usage, user behaviour, and key performance indicators in line with the existing Elevate implementation.
Integrate the OneTrust cookie compliance script within the Prismic-managed site to ensure GDPR and privacy regulation compliance. HD to provide the script for each domain (staging & prod).
Assign and implement a globally unique identifier (GUID) for the site to support analytics and system integrations.

blocks: The standard Trustpilot component already exists within the global component library, so no additional work is required. This assumes static reviews using the standard component. Live / dynamic reviews would need a Trustpilot ID and are not included.

extras: Benelux CRM (LeadHub) integration – form submissions are delivered by email only (see section {{ref:forms}})
Premium dealer types and priority ordering in the dealer locator (see section {{ref:locator}})
301 redirect mapping and implementation (to be handled by HD’s SEO agency)

sections.title: Timing plan
blocks: A detailed timing plan will be provided on approval of this SoW so the work can be planned in with the Code team. Working assumption based on the current roadmap is these locales will be worked on across February – March 2027, with both locales launching together in March 2027. Launch dates will be driven by HD once the detailed build plan has been agreed and finalised.

client_team: Digital Brand Manager: Provides any business logic or information and decisions for prioritisation. Key contact for existing system information and data requirements

dependencies: Assumption: Design token application follows already agreed design token governance
Dependency: Web licences for Manrope and Inter are confirmed and, where applicable, purchased by HD prior to the start of design token work
Dependency: HD to provide Dutch and French content, translations and form/system message copy, and to load all page content in Prismic
Dependency: HD to provide the dealer database (up to 140 dealers) in the existing Elevate format before locator build
Dependency: HD to export the blog / inspiration articles and images in the agreed format by the agreed date; volumes above 180 articles or a second full import would be a change request
Dependency: HD to provide email endpoints per form and locale, Turnstile keys and the OneTrust script for each domain (staging & prod)
Assumption: Products exist in Salsify in the data structure Elevate expects, with Dutch and French content
Assumption: 301 redirects will be mapped and implemented by HD’s SEO agency; any Code involvement would be a change request

clarifications.question: The brief says “pretty much the same as Duette EU”. Can you confirm the feature list in section 3 is complete, and that nothing else from Duette EU or the current Brightvale sites is expected?

clarifications.question: Are web licences for Manrope and Inter confirmed for both domains?

clarifications.question: Is email-only delivery of appointment requests OK for launch? LeadHub integration isn’t included.

clarifications.question: Where should email sign-up submissions go?

clarifications.question: What format is the dealer data in, who maintains it and how often? Is standard distance ordering OK instead of premium dealers first?

clarifications.question: Is it ~60 articles per language (≈120) or per locale-language (≈180)? Can you export them, with images, in an agreed format, and by when?

clarifications.question: Will your SEO agency produce the 301 redirect map and implement it, or do you need Code to implement it in Cloudflare?

clarifications.question: Are all Brightvale products already in Salsify with Dutch and French content? How many new categories, filters and specs are needed?
clarifications.why: PIM configuration is priced on the standard data structure
clarifications.assumption: Products in Salsify in the expected structure; counts confirmed at ticket scoping

clarifications.question: Is the standard (static) Trustpilot component OK, or do you need live reviews?
clarifications.why: Live reviews need a Trustpilot ID and aren’t priced

clarifications.question: Please confirm the GTM container and provide the OneTrust scripts for both domains (staging and prod).
